# Three.js

Vendored from the official npm package `three@0.186.1`, downloaded using `npm pack` with npm's normal HTTPS and integrity verification.

Runtime files: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`, and `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js` from that package. Import resolution uses the import map in `index.html`. The upstream MIT license is preserved at `three/LICENSE` and included in the deployed website.

No CDN connection, model download, or runtime package installation is required.
